reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Normally I used the blue one. First time to try this brightening one, looks good and it made my skin look brighter. Love it.
reviews.zh: 平時我都係用藍色嗰款。第一次試呢款提亮面膜，睇落唔錯，而且用完皮膚望落更亮澤。好鍾意。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: A fantastic, non-irritating Vitamin C mask. Brightens dull skin instantly and gentle formula that doesn't irritate sensitive skin
reviews.zh: 一款出色、唔刺激嘅維他命C面膜。即時提亮暗沉肌膚，配方溫和，敏感肌用都唔會受刺激。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: My skin looks less dull after using. The essence is too watery so I feel like the mask sheet dries out pretty quickly, but the good thing is it doesn’t feel sticky.
reviews.zh: 用完之後皮膚冇咁暗沉。精華太水，所以覺得面膜紙乾得幾快，但好處係唔會感到黏笠。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: I don’t like it I don’t think it really brighten my skin
reviews.zh: 我唔鍾意，我覺得佢無真正提亮到我嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Love the glow after I use it every time! It does really give that whitening effect after couple weeks later!
reviews.zh: 每次用完之後都鍾意嗰種光澤感！用咗幾個星期之後，真係有美白效果！

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: Moisturizing and refreshing. Not too sure about brightening properties, but still a nice and simple every day mask
reviews.zh: 保濕又清爽。對提亮效果唔太確定，但仍然係一款唔錯、簡單嘅日常面膜。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text: My skin usually breaks out when I use Vitamin C products, but with this one, I didn’t get any acne, which is great for me.My skin gets noticeably brighter when I use this
reviews.zh: 我平時用維他命C產品會爆瘡，但用呢款就冇生暗瘡，對我嚟講真係好。用完之後皮膚明顯變得更亮澤。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask Sheet 10ea
reviews.text:
Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask
This mask is a vitamin C boost for dull, tired skin! It brightens instantly while delivering gentle hydration. After use, my complexion looked more radiant, even-toned, and refreshed.

✨ The sheet fits snugly and stays put without slipping.
💧 Essence absorbs quickly, leaving skin soft and glowing.
🌿 Great for revitalizing dullness and boosting skin’s natural glow.

💛 Perfect for anyone wanting a quick brightness boost and a fresh, healthy complexion.
reviews.zh:
Torriden Cellmazing Vita C Brightening Mask
呢款面膜為暗沉、疲憊嘅肌膚注入維他命C！即時提亮之餘，同時提供溫和嘅保濕。用完之後，我嘅膚色望落更光澤、均勻同有神。

✨ 面膜紙貼面穩固，唔易滑落。
💧 精華吸收快，用完皮膚變得柔軟有光澤。
🌿 適合用嚟活化暗沉肌膚，提升皮膚自然光澤。

💛 適合想快速提亮、擁有清新健康膚色嘅人。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
